selected_goal_success_impact.reason: No holdout selected-goal assignments, goal commitment times or success definitions are supplied. Agent goal attainment cannot be compared to an invented holdout goal.

causal_scope: Triggered-cohort ITT uses a fixed supplied trigger roster that is generated independently of actions; includes all assigned agent users in that roster, including NO_ACTION. A causal interpretation is conditional on this exogenous-cohort assumption, valid randomization, comparable observation and no interference. It describes this synthetic simulator and seed, not real product impact.
missingness: Untriggered randomized users lack complete simulator follow-up: supplied live-event positives are retained, while other outcomes remain unknown, not zero. Full-population ITT rates, relative lift and confidence intervals are not estimable without assumptions. Reported population bounds are worst-case identification bounds, not confidence intervals.
multiplicity: Two exploratory endpoints are reported without multiple-testing adjustment; neither supports a pre-registered confirmatory claim.

biased_served_comparison.reason: Descriptive association only: served versus everyone else is not a randomized contrast and cannot identify causal uplift

pilot.selection_bias: Serving is a post-assignment choice that can select for activity, eligibility and opportunity to expose. Served versus everyone else mixes unserved treatment and holdout users and breaks randomization; its uplift is not causal.
pilot.limitations: Pilot succeeded fields are supplied labels, not independently verified events. G06 eligibility is underspecified; goal-specific observation coverage and censoring are unavailable. The randomized comparison estimates differences in supplied labels only, conditional on consistent measurement.
